rule: Each prediction is checked against every daily tracker row dated AFTER the registration day (data/history/tracker.jsonl). A prediction is met on a day when that row's point estimate satisfies the rule. On the horizon date it is graded 'held' if it was met on at least 80% of tracked days, otherwise 'failed'. The registration-day row is shown as the baseline and is not scored, because it was visible when these were written.

predictions.claim: Access stays closed: the five busiest signers keep submitting at least 90% of transactions
predictions.if_wrong: Relayer access is opening up. The main structural objection in this thesis weakens.

predictions.claim: The move to confidential settlement is permanent: at least 90% of visibly settled value is shielded
predictions.if_wrong: The collapse of public swaps was temporary, and the audit gap is smaller than we say.

predictions.claim: NEAR's take stays under 5 bps of published volume, measured over the trailing 30 days
predictions.if_wrong: Value capture is improving. The second structural objection weakens.

predictions.claim: It remains a dollar rail: stablecoins stay above half of the value moved
predictions.if_wrong: The flow is turning speculative, and the demand case needs rewriting.

predictions.claim: Demand persists: published volume stays at or above $100M a day
predictions.if_wrong: The volume was a one-month spike, and the bull case falls.
